questions.question:
A × B means A is the brother of B, A + B means A is the father of B, A - B means A is the sister of B and A ÷ B means A is the wife of B.

If P × Q ÷ H + D - B + M, then how is Q related to M?
questions.solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Father
 Sister
 Brother
 Wife 
 
 

 

Given: P × Q ÷ H + D - B + M

It means: P is the brother of Q, Q is the wife of H, H is the father of D, D is the sister of B and B is the father of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/501b12f9be81aed5c6439e2a1421663fcaa8b9b4c75a00816eb1dbeb75af3aaa.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952939b9e0922208593f5b760911a1f2b407d540dc1226864edf2c8213d4b470.png] 

So, Q is the '**Father's mother'** of M.

Hence, the correct answer is "Father's mother'.

Hence, the correct anwer is** "Heena".**

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known acts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. No Brush is Bed.

II. Some Table are Brush.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some Table are not Bed.

II. All Bed are Table.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
Statements:

I. No Brush is Bed.

II. Some Table are Brush.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6183277443f481b04a19310bf7eb54116631730121e9b150f548361e2791451.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some Table are not Bed. - **True **(because, No Brush is Bed and Some Table are Brush so which part of table intersect with brush will not be bed, it is definite)

II. All Bed are Table. - **False **(because, No Brush is Bed and Some Table are Brush so all bed ca never be table)

So, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Only conclusion I follows".**

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

14 × 4 ÷ 6 + 5 - 8 = 3
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f1f11fbb4e091305a6b414e74c3aec25b8d519670a1f3bd65f5bd4eb1bdcd68.png] 

Given equation: 14 × 4 ÷ 6 + 5 - 8 = 3

Option 1) 3 and 5

After interchanging the numbers we get:

⇒ __**14 × 4 ÷ 6**__ + 3 - 8 = 5

⇒ __9.33____** + 3**__ - 8 = 5

⇒ __12.3____**3**____** - 8**__ = 5

⇒ 4.33 = 5

**Option 2) 3 and 4**

After interchanging the numbers we get:

⇒ __**14 × 3 ÷ 6 **__+ 5 - 8 = 4

⇒ __7____ **+ 5**__ - 8 = 4

⇒ __**12 - 8**__ = 4

**⇒ 4 = 4**

Option 3) 8 and 4

After interchanging the numbers we get:

⇒ __**14 × 8 ÷ 6**__ + 5 - 4 = 3

⇒ __18.67__**__ + 5__** - 4 = 3

⇒ __**23.67 - 4**__ = 3

⇒ 19.67 = 3

Option 4) 14 and 6

After interchanging the numbers we get:

⇒ __**6 × 4 ÷ 14**__ + 5 - 8 = 3

⇒ __**1.71 + 5**__ - 8 = 3

⇒ __**6.71 - 8**__ = 3

⇒ 1.29 = 3

Hence, the correct answer is "3 and 4".
